title: Readiness without scraping, and a gate that claims only what it saw
description:
Kill the last screen scrape, and stop the error message asserting a cause it
never observed.

Screen scraping is already nearly eliminated in ticks: exactly ONE pane read
exists in the whole repo, and the rule against scraping is written into both the
worker prompt (spawn/prompt.go:106, "Your terminal output is not read") and
skills/ticks/references/herdr-runner.md. This tick closes the hole.

The hole is the first-round-trip gate (spawn/spawn.go:496-527, Classify at
:549-561). It types a probe into the composer, reads the pane back with
SourceRecentUnwrapped, whitespace-normalises, finds the LAST index of the probe
string, and looks for an answer word after it.

Three defects:
- A rendering change produces no findable echo, which classifies as a silent
  drop, is retried maxGateAttempts times, and is then raised as a hard spawn
  failure whose message asserts "the agent started clean and cannot do work
  (stale model string, auth or quota)" (spawn.go:210). It never observed any of
  that. THIS IS NOT HYPOTHETICAL: during the Phase 1 gate run a Claude session
  usage limit presented as this exact message, and the orchestrator spent real
  time diagnosing a composer that was fine.
- PaneReadResult.Truncated (types.go:221) exists and is IGNORED at the call site
  (spawn.go:496-505). A read that merely cut off the echo is indistinguishable
  from a prompt that never arrived.
- Readiness is a 250ms poll of agent.get because there is no push event
  (spawn.go:429-453), flipping about a second after idle.

Do:
- Establish readiness over the PROTOCOL. Prefer an acknowledgement the agent
  sends, or an event, over any rendered text. If a pane read must remain as a
  last-resort fallback, it must honour Truncated and it must never be the sole
  basis for a hard failure.
- A gate failure states ONLY what was observed: "no acknowledgement within N" is
  the finding; auth, quota and a stale model string are hypotheses and must be
  offered as such if at all.
- Distinguish "the probe was not delivered", "the read was truncated" and "the
  agent answered something unexpected". Today all three are one classification.
